description: Complete the per-receptor column table: map the five demonstrated E. coli Tsr modification columns onto every B. subtilis chemoreceptor by structural superposition, and test Gln occupancy against the local background frequency
code:
import numpy as np, re, requests, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ---------------- 1. enumerate the B. subtilis 168 chemoreceptors ----------------
q=("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?query=organism_id:224308+AND+"
   "(xref:pfam-PF00015)&fields=accession,id,protein_name,length&format=json&size=50")
j=requests.get(q,timeout=60).json()
recs={r["primaryAccession"]:(r["uniProtkbId"],r["sequence"]["length"]) for r in j["results"]}
print("B. subtilis 168 proteins with an MCPsignal (PF00015) domain:",len(recs))
for a,(i,L) in sorted(recs.items(),key=lambda x:x[1][0]): print(f"   {a}  {i:16s} {L} aa")

ACC_REF="P02942"   # E. coli Tsr
def fasta(a): return "".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=30).text.strip().split("\n")[1:])
SEQ={a:fasta(a) for a in list(recs)+[ACC_REF]}
TIPRE=re.compile(r"G[FLIV][ASG]VVA[DEG]EVR")
tip={a:(TIPRE.search(s).start()+1 if TIPRE.search(s) else None) for a,s in SEQ.items()}
print("\ntip anchor found for",sum(v is not None for v in tip.values()),"of",len(tip))
for a,v in tip.items():
    if v is None: print("   no tip motif:",a,recs.get(a,("Tsr",0))[0])

# ---------------- 2. AlphaFold models ----------------
def get_af(a,fn):
    import os
    if os.path.exists(fn): return fn
    r=requests.get(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/{a}",timeout=60)
    if r.status_code!=200: return None
    u=r.json()[0].get("pdbUrl")
    if not u: return None
    open(fn,"w").write(requests.get(u,timeout=120).text); return fn
FILES={}
for a in list(recs)+[ACC_REF]:
    nm={"P39215":"mcpB_af.pdb","P54576":"mcpC_af.pdb","P39214":"mcpA_af.pdb","P02942":"tsr_af.pdb"}.get(a,f"af_{a}.pdb")
    f=get_af(a,nm); FILES[a]=f
print("\nAlphaFold models obtained:",sum(f is not None for f in FILES.values()),"of",len(FILES))

# ---------------- 3. structural superposition machinery (as validated in iteration 2) ----------------
def read_ca(path):
    out={}
    for l in open(path):
        if not l.startswith("ATOM") or l[12:16].strip()!="CA" or l[16] not in (" ","A"): continue
        out[int(l[22:26])]=(np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])]),float(l[60:66]))
    return out
def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc,qc=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0); H=(P-pc).T@(Q-qc); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T)); R=Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,d])@U.T; return R,qc-R@pc
def lis(v):
    n=len(v); b=[1]*n; p=[-1]*n
    for i in range(n):
        for jx in range(i):
            if v[jx]<v[i] and b[jx]+1>b[i]: b[i]=b[jx]+1; p[i]=jx
    i=int(np.argmax(b)); o=[]
    while i!=-1: o.append(i); i=p[i]
    return sorted(o)
def struct_align(ref,mob,seed,n_iter=12):
    pairs=list(seed); rk=sorted(ref); mk=sorted(mob); MM=np.array([mob[k][0] for k in mk])
    for it in range(n_iter):
        P=np.array([mob[b][0] for a,b in pairs]); Q=np.array([ref[a][0] for a,b in pairs])
        R,t=kabsch(P,Q); MT=(R@MM.T).T+t
        c=9.0 if it<3 else (6.0 if it<6 else 4.0); cand=[]
        for a in rk:
            d=np.linalg.norm(MT-ref[a][0],axis=1); jx=int(np.argmin(d))
            if d[jx]<c: cand.append((a,mk[jx]))
        cand.sort(); new=[cand[i] for i in lis([b for a,b in cand])]
        if len(new)<15 or new==pairs: break
        pairs=new
    P=np.array([mob[b][0] for a,b in pairs]); Q=np.array([ref[a][0] for a,b in pairs])
    R,t=kabsch(P,Q); dd=np.sqrt((((R@P.T).T+t-Q)**2).sum(1))
    return pairs,float(np.sqrt((dd**2).mean())),dict(zip([a for a,b in pairs],dd))

CA={a:read_ca(f) for a,f in FILES.items() if f}
TSR=CA[ACC_REF]; TSR_TM=210
ref={r:v for r,v in TSR.items() if r>TSR_TM}
COLS=[(297,"Q297","demonstrated deamidation (Tar Q295)"),(304,"E304","methyl-accepting Glu (Tar E302)"),
      (311,"Q311","demonstrated deamidation (Tar Q309)"),(493,"E493","methyl-accepting Glu (Tar E491)"),
      (502,"E502","methyl-accepting Glu")]

rows=[]
for a in recs:
    if a not in CA or tip[a] is None: 
        rows.append(dict(acc=a,name=recs[a][0],note="no tip motif or no model")); continue
    mob={r:v for r,v in CA[a].items() if r> max(1,tip[a]-230)}      # cytoplasmic region, generous
    seed=[(tip[ACC_REF]+i,tip[a]+i) for i in range(10) if (tip[ACC_REF]+i) in ref and (tip[a]+i) in mob]
    if len(seed)<8: rows.append(dict(acc=a,name=recs[a][0],note="seed failed")); continue
    pairs,rms,dev=struct_align(ref,mob,seed); mp=dict(pairs)
    d=dict(acc=a,name=recs[a][0],n_aligned=len(pairs),rmsd=round(rms,2))
    for p,c,role in COLS:
        qq=mp.get(p)
        d[c]=f"{SEQ[a][qq-1]}{qq}" if qq else "-"
        d[c+"_dev"]=round(dev[p],2) if qq else None
    rows.append(d)
T=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print("\n=== residue occupying each demonstrated E. coli Tsr modification column in every B. subtilis chemoreceptor ===")
print(T[["acc","name","n_aligned","rmsd"]+[c for _,c,_ in COLS]].to_string(index=False))
T.to_csv("all_receptors_column_table.csv",index=False)

# ---------------- 4. Gln occupancy vs base rate ----------------
hits=[]; nq=0; ntot=0
for _,r in T.iterrows():
    if "n_aligned" not in r or pd.isna(r.get("n_aligned")): continue
    for p,c,role in COLS:
        v=r[c]
        if v=="-": continue
        ntot+=1
        if v[0]=="Q": nq+=1; hits.append((r["name"],c,v,role))
base=[]
for a in recs:
    if a in CA and tip[a]:
        seg=SEQ[a][max(0,tip[a]-150):tip[a]+130]           # the two methylation helices
        base.append(seg.count("Q")/len(seg))
bq=float(np.mean(base))
from scipy.stats import binomtest
bt=binomtest(nq,ntot,bq,alternative="greater")
print(f"\nGln occupancy at mapped columns: {nq}/{ntot} = {nq/ntot:.3f}")
print(f"Background Gln frequency in the methylation-helix region: {bq:.3f} (mean over {len(base)} receptors)")
print(f"Exact binomial p (one-sided, enrichment) = {bt.pvalue:.3f}; enrichment ratio {nq/ntot/bq:.2f}x")
print("\nGln hits:")
for h in hits: print("   ",h)
print("\nGln on a DEMONSTRATED deamidation column:",[h for h in hits if h[3].startswith("demonstrated")])

# ---------------- 5. figure ----------------
sub=T.dropna(subset=["n_aligned"]).reset_index(drop=True)
M=np.zeros((len(sub),5)); lab=np.empty((len(sub),5),dtype=object)
for i,r in sub.iterrows():
    for jx,(p,c,role) in enumerate(COLS):
        v=r[c]; lab[i,jx]=v
        M[i,jx]=0 if v=="-" else (2 if v[0]=="Q" else (1.5 if v[0]=="E" else 1))
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,0.52*len(sub)+2.6))
ax.imshow(M,cmap=plt.matplotlib.colors.ListedColormap(["0.9","#cfe2f3","#9fc5e8","#e06666"]),vmin=0,vmax=2,aspect="auto")
ax.set_xticks(range(5)); ax.set_xticklabels([f"Tsr {c}\n{'deamidated' if c[0]=='Q' else 'Glu site'}" for _,c,_ in COLS])
ax.set_yticks(range(len(sub))); ax.set_yticklabels([n.replace("_BACSU","") for n in sub["name"]])
for i in range(len(sub)):
    for jx in range(5): ax.text(jx,i,lab[i,jx],ha="center",va="center",fontsize=8)
ax.set_title("Residue at each demonstrated E. coli modification column in the B. subtilis chemoreceptors\n"
             "red = glutamine (would need deamidation), blue = glutamate, pale = other",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
